about: Qwen3.5-9B EXL3 6.00 bpw with GPU vision on one RX 7900 XTX. 128K variant of the accepted 256K launch; only the context window differs.

config.text:
network:
  host: 127.0.0.1
  port: 5091
  disable_auth: true
  allowed_origins: []
logging:
  log_prompt: false
  log_requests: false
model:
  model_dir: ../models
  model_name: Qwen3.5-9B-exl3-6.00bpw
  backend: exllamav3
  max_seq_len: 131072
  cache_size: 131072
  cache_mode: FP16
  max_batch_size: 1
  chunk_size: 8192
  vision: true
  vision_offload: false
  reasoning: true
  tool_format: qwen3_coder
draft_model:
  draft_mode: disabled
  draft_num_tokens: 0

setup: Linux gfx1100; host amdgpu driver and uv. Run setup/install.sh from the pinned install repository, download the pinned weights to the stated directory, and replace serve/config.yml with this launch config. Python 3.12, TabbyAPI e086a65, ExLlamaV3 1.6.3 and PyTorch 2.13.0 ROCm 10.0.0 are pinned by its package lock. No transformer-layer or vision-encoder offload; upstream keeps the unquantized token embedding table in host RAM. Disable the Ryzen iGPU with HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0. Loopback port 5091. Host launch; not offered by the Docker-only plugin.
